cases.coverage: Portable function-tool continuation reselects an independent healthy candidate without rerunning the tool.
A truly provider-parked source retains its message, owner and deadline while a timer consumes only the fresh interjection.
A real helper HTTP 503 cools the scope; an already-executed native tool continuation waits with zero IO, query/event cause and deadline, then finishes once on the same model.
A real post-tool HTTP failure plus concurrent shared A/B HTTP failures retain the scheduler-parked runtime recovery input until deadline, preserve owner and tool evidence, and consume it once.
cases.excludes: Does not synthesize the admission-to-send race: Interrupted recovery-input retention after an already-granted admission remains a Rust regression gate.
